name: Intel 8051 Serial Hello
desc: Intel 8051 - Send 'Hello 8051' string to serial monitor via SBUF register.
code:
; Intel 8051 - Serial Hello World
; Sends 'Hello 8051' to the serial monitor
; Uses timer baud rate setup and SBUF output

        ORG 0000H

        ; Setup timer for serial baud rate
        MOV TMOD, #20H   ; Timer1, Mode 2 (8-bit auto-reload)
        MOV TH1, #0FDH   ; 9600 baud @ 11.0592MHz
        MOV SCON, #50H   ; Mode 1, REN=1 (8-bit UART)
        SETB TR1          ; Start Timer1

        MOV DPTR, #MSG   ; DPTR = message pointer

NEXT:   CLR A             ; Clear A for MOVC
        MOVC A, @A+DPTR  ; Load next character
        JZ DONE          ; If null, done
        MOV SBUF, A      ; Send character
        JNB TI, $        ; Wait for TX complete
        CLR TI           ; Clear TI flag
        INC DPTR         ; Next character
        SJMP NEXT        ; Loop

DONE:   SJMP $           ; Halt (infinite loop)

MSG:    DB 'Hello 8051', 0DH, 0AH, 00H
        END
